name: Mercury Editor Content Lock
description: Integrates the Content Lock module with the Mercury Editor.
project_description:
This module provides UI integration between Mercury Editor and Content Locking . 

 Features 
 When Mercury Editor and Content Locking are both enabled on a given content type, editors are provided an unlock button to unlock the content and throw away their current changes. When attempting to edit content that has a lock, the interface is disabled and editors are shown a modal explaining why the content is locked. If editors have permission to break the lock, they will also be presented with an unlock option. 

 Post-Installation 
 Install and configure Mercury Editor and Content Lock as normal. This module provides no additional configuration options. 

 Additional Requirements 
 
 Mercury Editor 
 Content Locking
